final_message: PJR-WP44: not_applicable judgement now uses the run's target project for specdojo catalog validate (--project, then the project whose execution path matches, then current_project). It also uses the declared product repository's package.json for commands with a <repo>:<path> argument or --prefix <repo>. The run's project is carried as runner_scope on the reporter-only evidence so evidenceForReporter and deriveReporterFacts agree. The executor prompt now lists the not_applicable rejection conditions. Added unit tests in tests/src/exec-reporter.test.ts, which have not run yet; parent runner owns test-unit and typecheck. Updated exec-config-guide, exec-operation-guide and the PJR-WP44 ticket's 対応結果 section. Changed: src/exec-reporter.ts, src/exec-run.ts, tests/src/exec-reporter.test.ts, docs/ja/specdojo/guides/exec-config-guide.md, docs/ja/specdojo/guides/exec-operation-guide.md, docs/ja/projects/prj-0001/controls/project-register/pjr-wp44-not-applicable-reason-criteria.md.
